commentary.text: 90+5' The referee blows his whistle for the final time to end this match.
90+5' Michael Kayode plays a lofted ball into Kevin Schade (Brentford) near the penalty spot, but the ball flies off the top of his head and goes high over the bar.
90+4' The attendance for today's match is 17154.
90+3' Dane Scarlett (Tottenham) finds himself beyond the last defender but the linesman raises his flag for offside.
90+2' Jarred Gillett blows his whistle after Michael Kayode (Brentford) kicks an opponent's legs instead of the ball. A free kick is awarded to Tottenham.
90+1' Bryan Mbeumo (Brentford) fires the ball from the free kick just outside the box, but he misdirects his shot high over the bar.
90' The fourth official shows 4 min. of added time.
90' Ben Davies (Tottenham) fouls an opponent. At least that's what referee Jarred Gillett signals. A free kick has been awarded to Brentford.
87' 0 - 2 Goal Pape Matar Sarr (Tottenham)! Pape Matar Sarr (Tottenham) was put through by Heung-Min Son and he showed brilliant composure inside the box to fire into the bottom left corner. 0:2.
86' Fabio Carvalho (Brentford) fires the ball towards the right side of the goal from close-range, but his shot is blocked by one of the defenders.
84' The referee allows time for a substitution. Christian Norgaard will be replaced by Fabio Carvalho (Brentford).
84' Dejan Kulusevski (Tottenham) attempts to find Dane Scarlett, but puts far too much on the pass and the chance is gone. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Brentford.
84' Heung-Min Son (Tottenham) steps up to take the corner. He launches the ball into the penalty area, but it only finds the head of an opposing player who clears the danger.

83' Heung-Min Son (Tottenham) attempts to find one of his teammates with a sweet pass into the box, but one of the defending players reacts well and intercepts the effort. Tottenham force a corner. They send men into the box.
80' What a miskick by Keane Lewis-Potter (Brentford). He smashes a volley from long distance that goes into the stands.
79' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Richarlison leaves the pitch and Dane Scarlett (Tottenham) comes on.
78' Jarred Gillett blows the whistle, Sepp van den Berg (Brentford) is penalised for a foul. That's a free kick to Tottenham.

77' Sepp van den Berg (Brentford) attempts to convert a cross into a goal, but his promising header from near the penalty spot towards the middle of the net is denied by Antonin Kinsky. This effort really didn't trouble him.
77' Bryan Mbeumo (Brentford) steps up to take the corner, but the ball just sails in among the defenders.
76' Michael Kayode (Brentford) delivers a low pass into the box which is intercepted. The ball goes out of play and Brentford have been awarded a corner kick.
76' Substitution. Michael Kayode (Brentford) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Kristoffer Ajer walks off.
75' Bryan Mbeumo (Brentford) rolls the ball short to a teammate from the corner instead of sending a cross into the box.
74' A long cross from the side is directed to the well-positioned Yoane Wissa (Brentford), but the defence gets it clear. Brentford force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
72' The ball is cleared after Bryan Mbeumo (Brentford) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
71' Total attempts – 14:12. The number of shots on goal at present is 2:1.
70' Bryan Mbeumo (Brentford) fails to deliver a decent cross from the corner and the ball goes out of play. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Tottenham.
70' Bryan Mbeumo (Brentford) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked. Brentford will take a corner kick.
68' Kevin Schade lays the ball off to Mathias Jensen (Brentford), who hurriedly shoots from long range and sends the ball high over the bar into row Z.
68' Ange Postecoglou has decided to make a change. Pape Matar Sarr (Tottenham) replaces Yves Bissouma.
67' Bryan Mbeumo (Brentford) takes the corner, but one of the defenders reacts well and rises highest to head the ball away.
66' The referee signals a substitution. Mathias Jensen (Brentford) is brought on as a substitute for Vitaly Janelt.

66' Kristoffer Ajer (Brentford) releases a low pass from just outside the box in an attempt to find his teammate, but one of the defenders calmly averts the threat. The ball goes out of play. Brentford are awarded a corner kick.
63' The corner from Mikkel Damsgaard (Brentford) is hurriedly cleared.
63' Mikkel Damsgaard (Brentford) gets to the rebound just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by one of the defending players. Brentford have been awarded a corner kick.
60' Lucas Bergvall (Tottenham) steadies himself on the edge of the box and releases a precise effort on goal that just narrowly sails past the right post.
56' Keane Lewis-Potter (Brentford) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Antonin Kinsky, who smothers the ball.
55' Dejan Kulusevski (Tottenham) is free in the box and Rodrigo Bentancur finds him with a pass, but his powerful shot skims just past the right post. Good chance!
54' Yoane Wissa (Brentford) wastes a huge chance as he sends a first-time shot from the goal area straight onto the crossbar!

52' Christian Norgaard (Brentford) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Antonin Kinsky intercepts the ball. The ball rebounds to Kevin Schade (Brentford) inside the box after a goalmouth scramble, but he whips the ball high over bar.
51' Kevin Schade (Brentford) fails to pick a body out in the box with an over-hit cross to the back post. The ball goes out of play and Tottenham will have a goal kick.
50' Heung-Min Son (Tottenham) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.

50' Bryan Mbeumo (Brentford) attempts to find some of his teammates with a dangerous pass from the edge of the box. The opponent's defence, however, intercepts the effort and clears the ball to safety.
48' Bryan Mbeumo (Brentford) sends over a free kick from long range but the defence is alert.
46' The teams are back out for the second half and here is a change on the pitch. Ange Postecoglou gives a chance to Lucas Bergvall (Tottenham) and Mikey Moore is off.
46' The half-time break is over and the second half is about to start.
45+3' The match has reached half-time.
45+3' Pedro Porro (Tottenham) produces a dangerous low pass into the penalty area, but the defence manage to cut it out.
45+2' Bryan Mbeumo (Brentford) gets to the rebound just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by one of the defending players.
45+2' Mikkel Damsgaard (Brentford) takes the corner which is cleared by the opposition's defence.

45+1' Mikkel Damsgaard (Brentford) lifts the ball into the box from the corner, but one of the defending players gets there first to head it clear. Brentford force their opponents to concede a corner.
45+1' Bryan Mbeumo (Brentford) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out. The ball is out of play and Brentford manage to earn a corner.
45' 2 additional min. will be played.
44' Richarlison (Tottenham) goes down in the box after a challenge from the defender. Possibly unsighted, the referee just waves play on.

43' Bryan Mbeumo (Brentford) attempts to find one of his teammates with a ball from a free kick outside the box. The goalkeeper climbs high above all the players in the box to intercept the cross and snuff out the opportunity.
41' Heung-Min Son (Tottenham) will have to be careful for the rest of the match as he is shown a yellow card.
41' Yves Bissouma (Tottenham) had an opportunity from long range. His low shot was directed towards the middle of the goal, but Hakon Rafn Valdimarsson was alert and made a comfortable save.
39' Heung-Min Son bends the corner in towards the goal and finds Dejan Kulusevski (Tottenham) almost on the goal line, but he somehow contrives to head the ball high over the bar.
39' Heung-Min Son (Tottenham) will deliver the ball into the penalty box from a corner kick.

37' Heung-Min Son (Tottenham) unleashed a monstrous piledriver. He controlled a pass, glanced up at goal and shot from the edge of the box. It could have been a difficult one for the keeper, but the ball fortunately hit one of the defenders and ball bounced away.
36' Mikkel Damsgaard crosses the ball right onto the head of Kevin Schade (Brentford), but his firm header from around the penalty spot shoots well wide of the right post.
35' Dejan Kulusevski (Tottenham) sprays a pass out to Mikey Moore, but he can't beat his man inside the box.
34' Bryan Mbeumo (Brentford) works the corner short instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.

33' Christian Norgaard (Brentford) finds himself some space inside the box, collects a rebound and sends an effort in on goal. Antonin Kinsky pulls off a fantastic reflex save to stop the ball going under the crossbar. Brentford earn a corner.
33' 5:8 – this is the total number of shots produced by both teams. The shots on goal statistics – 1:1.
32' Kristoffer Ajer (Brentford) looks to break free, but his touch lets him down and he loses the ball. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Tottenham.
31' The resulting corner from Bryan Mbeumo (Brentford) comes to nothing.
29' 0 - 1 It's an own goal! An unlucky moment for Vitaly Janelt (Brentford), who heads the corner kick behind his own keeper. The score is 0:1.
29' Heung-Min Son (Tottenham) takes the ball to the corner flag and sends it into the box.

28' Heung-Min Son (Tottenham) strikes the ball towards goal, but it fails to reach the target after being well blocked by one of the defenders. Yves Bissouma (Tottenham) reacts well to get to the rebound and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but he fails to get the ball through the players standing between him and the goal. Corner kick. Tottenham will have an opportunity.

27' Bryan Mbeumo (Brentford) beats the defender inside the box and lashes a shot towards the bottom right corner, but Antonin Kinsky makes a brilliant reflex save to deny him. Goalkeeping at its best!
26' Rodrigo Bentancur (Tottenham) sends a long cross over to Richarlison, but Hakon Rafn Valdimarsson comes forward to gather the ball.
25' Pedro Porro (Tottenham) gets the ball and drives a shot high over the bar from the edge of the area.
24' Djed Spence (Tottenham) hammers the ball from far out, but his shot is blocked by an opposition player.
23' Mikkel Damsgaard almost gets into in a promising position, but the through ball by Bryan Mbeumo (Brentford) from just inside the box is intercepted by one of the defending players.
23' He should have done better. Yoane Wissa (Brentford) is afforded space to connect with a Vitaly Janelt cross, but his header from the centre of the box flies well over the crossbar.
22' Bryan Mbeumo (Brentford) whips the ball in, but it fails to reach any of his teammates as the opposition's defence averts the threat.
20' Dejan Kulusevski (Tottenham) gets on the end of a pass and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's blocked by one of the defending players.
20' Keane Lewis-Potter (Brentford) plays a long ball to Mikkel Damsgaard, but the defence is well organised and manages to get it clear.
19' The defender bravely blocks the shot from Kevin Schade (Brentford) inside the box.
17' Djed Spence (Tottenham) threads a pass through the eye of a needle into the box for Richarlison, but Hakon Rafn Valdimarsson displays great awareness to stop him.
14' Pedro Porro (Tottenham) trips an opponent with a slide tackle. Jarred Gillett stops the game and he could give him a card, but eventually decides on just a warning.
12' Great ball in from Bryan Mbeumo. Yoane Wissa (Brentford) should really have done better with a close-range header, but he heads it a whisker over the crossbar.
10' The foul by Pedro Porro (Tottenham) was seen by Jarred Gillett who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.
9' Mikkel Damsgaard (Brentford) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates.

9' Kevin Schade (Brentford) passes the ball from the edge of the box in order to find his teammate, who is in a good scoring position, but the defender blocks the pass and spanks the ball to safety. The linesman makes the right call and Brentford will have a corner.
6' Chance! Richarlison (Tottenham) was in a good position inside the box, but he couldn't connect with the pass as it was overhit.

5' Pedro Porro (Tottenham) attempted to send a defence-splitting pass into space where Dejan Kulusevski was lurking. It could have put him one-on-one with the goalkeeper, but one of the defending players somehow manages to avert the threat.
4' Kristoffer Ajer (Brentford) sends a long ball in, but Antonin Kinsky comfortably gathers the ball.
3' Mikkel Damsgaard (Brentford) shoots inside the box, but is denied by a timely block.
1' The first half has just begun.
Brentford will kick the game off.
Jarred Gillett is the one to supervise the game today.
